notablePrerequisites: You have a Desert land card in hand or in your graveyard that enters the battlefield untapped.
description:
Play Arid Archway from your hand or your graveyard.
When Arid Archway enters, it, Kodama and Hazezon trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hazezon trigger, creating two 1/1 Sand Warrior creature tokens.
When the Sand Warriors enter, Kodama triggers twice.
Resolve the first Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the second Kodama trigger from step 6, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
